title: imgdiff
description: How two images differ, exactly and perceptually: how many pixels changed, by how much, and the difference hash of each. The two must be the same size -- comparing different sizes is a different question, not a smaller difference.

capture.description: the capture the command was run against (unused)

percentDiffering.description: a percentage with three decimals, as text: the writer has no fractional field

meanDelta.description: average channel difference over changed pixels, three decimals

heatMap.description: the difference image written, empty when --out was not given
